summary.text: Rob Bresnahan Jr. is the Republican incumbent for Pennsylvania's 8th District, elected in 2024 after defeating then-incumbent Matt Cartwright. Before Congress he was chief executive officer of his family's electrical contracting company, Kuharchik Construction, and founded a real estate development group. He serves on the Transportation and Infrastructure, Agriculture and Small Business committees.

paragraphs.text: Bresnahan was born in 1990 in Kingston, Pennsylvania, and raised in the Wyoming Valley, where, according to his official biography, he helped in his family's electrical contracting business as a child.
He earned a B.S. in business administration from the University of Scranton in 2012.

In 2013 he became chief executive officer of Kuharchik Construction, a commercial electrical contractor, which according to his official biography grew to more than 150 employees under his leadership.
Bresnahan founded a real estate development group focused on renovating and repurposing buildings and was owner of RPB Ventures, a real estate development company.
According to his official biography, the Northeastern Pennsylvania Business Journal named him one of its 20 Under 40 in 2018.

Before Congress he served as chairman of a Joint Apprentice Training Committee, as a trustee of IBEW Local 163 benefit funds, and as treasurer of the nonprofit tecBridge; he was also president of the Luzerne County SPCA and sat on boards including Junior Achievement, Big Brothers Big Sisters of Northeastern Pennsylvania and the Luzerne County Industrial Development Authority.
Bresnahan won his first election in November 2024, defeating incumbent Democrat Matt Cartwright 50.7% to 49.1%.

In Congress he serves on the Transportation and Infrastructure, Agriculture and Small Business committees and is vice chair of the Transportation and Infrastructure Subcommittee on Highways and Transit.

According to his official biography, he is a member of caucuses including the Problem Solvers Caucus and the Congressional Apprenticeship Caucus, is a licensed helicopter pilot, and lives in Northeastern Pennsylvania with his wife, Chelsea.
